caption:
Sit up straight, slump, sit up again. Momo has been chasing the perfect desk posture for weeks.

Current evidence suggests no one sitting position protects your back or neck. What tends to help is changing position often and having the strength and mobility to sit comfortably for longer. Clinical Pilates trains upper back strength, moves your spine in directions desk work skips, and helps you notice when you've slumped.

Try a 2-minute reset after each meeting: three slow breaths, five seated twists each way, five shoulder blade squeezes. Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio starts with an assessment. Book online via the link in bio.
